referenceFunction.generalComment: Multi-output process providing the products "round wood, primary forest, clear-cutting, at forest road" and "provision, stubbed land". Emissions from wood burning and land transformation are allocated to the provision of stubbed land. The round wood dataset must not be used as a basis for comparison with tropical wood from sustainable forest management. The environmental impacts of tropical wood from clear-cutting must be evaluated in combination with the environmental impacts related to the provision of stubbed land.; UUID: 1998c8e2-f2ac-3706-92fd-f4ca65f44bb9
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Resources (wood, carbon, land), land transformation, emissions from wood burning, rough estimation for machinery use. Construction of roads and transports of wood not included.
referenceFunction.name: Provision, stubbed land

technology.text: Clear-cutting of primary forests with burning of biomass.

representativeness.extrapolations: Rough estimation of machinery use with European forestry data. Emissions profile for tropical forest per kg of dry biomass.
